title: HB315 (2026 Regular): AN ACT relating to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Introduced, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/26RS/hb315/orig_bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 3306473))

operative_text:
Section 2 (new section of KRS Chapter 527): (1) Except as provided in subsection (2) of this section, a person is guilty of possession of an assault weapon when he or she intentionally manufactures, sells, transfers, purchases, receives, or possesses an assault weapon.
Section 2 (new section of KRS Chapter 527): (4) Possession of an assault weapon is a Class D felony.
Section 3 (new section of KRS Chapter 527): (1) A person is guilty of possession of a machine gun when he or she intentionally manufactures, sells, transfers, purchases, receives, or possesses a machine gun.
Section 3 (new section of KRS Chapter 527): (3) Possession of a machine gun is a Class C felony.
Section 4 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (1) A person who may lawfully possess an assault weapon under subsection (2)(b) of Section 2 of this Act may, within one (1) year of the effective date of this Act, apply to the commissioner of the Department of Kentucky State Police for a certificate of possession.
